Plan-approval pending issues are not classified into the amber Needs you group

## Required action

Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with:

`pan review request PAN-2450 -m "Fixed review issues"`

    407|   });

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[11/12]⎯

TypeError: undefined is not iterable (cannot read property Symbol(Symbol.iterator))
 ❯ tests/unit/lib/pan-444-post-merge-step0.test.ts:412:26

    411|
    412|     const [scriptPath] = mockSpawn.mock.calls[0];
       |                          ^
    413|     // scripts/post-merge-deploy.sh should be a direct child of repoRo…
    414|     // not nested inside src/ or lib/

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[12/12]⎯



## REQUIRED: Fix the failing check, push, and request a new review

1. Read the error output above carefully
2. Fix the code causing the failure
3. Run the failing check locally to verify it passes
4. Commit every change
5. Invoke the /rebase-and-submit skill for PAN-2450 — this is an atomic task. Because verification already ran once (a PR exists), the skill will push your branch and run `pan review request PAN-2450 -m "Fixed test"` for you. NEVER curl `/api/review/...` or any dashboard endpoint — `pan review request` is the only supported re-entry point.

Do NOT stop between steps. Do NOT stop after pushing. Do NOT stop until `pan review request` has completed successfully.
